verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes strong source-moment selection as an acceptance condition for the trial clips; the administrative Thursday deadline is correctly excluded.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports completing the clips while prioritizing strong moments.
Replacing the trial-clip artifact with a screening form makes its moment-selection acceptance condition obsolete; the removed key existed in prior state and does not overlap an update.
First concrete client verification: review of the submitted clips found the moment capturing to be on point.
The client establishes a concrete clip-content acceptance condition requiring selected moments to teach something or provide a real lesson.
First concrete failure under the substantive-moment standard: client review requires moments that deliver a meaningful lesson or story rather than a fragment or highlight.
Post-revision persistence with a partial outcome: one clip passed, while seven still lacked sufficiently impactful moments.
The client defines the ongoing production acceptance rule as selecting a full lesson, story, or real point and extends it to persistent monthly short-form production.
